title: Phage DNA Extraction and Digestion to Single Nucleosides
author: Atanas Radkov
materials: Use a Nucleoside Digestion Mix (NEB - M0649S) to digest 1 µg of DNA. Each reaction should contain 1 µL of Nucleoside Digestion Mix and 2 µL of 10× Nucleoside Digestion Mix buffer.

Aliquot 300 µL of concentrated phage into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube. This will be used for DNA harvest with the NEB Monarch HMW DNA Extraction Kit for Tissue (NEB T3060L), using the modifications for bacteriophages suggested by NEB in their extremely helpful technical note. TechNote_Fast_efficient_isolation_phage_gDNA_Monarch_HMW_DNA_Extraction_Kits.pdf

To degrade any non-encapsulated nucleic acids, treat the concentrated phage lysate with 10 µg/mL RNase A (NEB T3018) and 10 µg/mL DNase I (NEB M0303). Digest for 1 h at room temperature or 4 °C overnight. Store phage at 4 °C.

steps.title: Lyse Phage Samples
steps.instruction: Lyse the aliquoted phage using lysis buffer and proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL HMW gDNA tissue lysis buffer and 20 µL proteinase K to the aliquoted phage.
Incubate at 56 °C for 45 minutes on a Thermomixer at 250 rpm (or vortex every 10 min if using a static heat block).

steps.title: Separate Proteins
steps.instruction: Separate proteins from the lysate and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of protein separation solution with gentle mixing.
Spin down at 16 × g for 10 min.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate the aqueous layer and initiate DNA precipitation using capture beads and isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Move the aqueous layer (approximately 900 µL) to a fresh 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add two DNA capture beads to the aqueous layer.
Add 550 µL of isopropanol to the tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the capture beads via rotation or inversion.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube on a rotator at the slowest speed for 5 min, or perform 25 slow and gentle manual inversions.

steps.title: Wash DNA Beads
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and wash the DNA-bound beads.

substeps.instruction: Pipette off the liquid from the beads.
Wash the beads twice with 500 µL of DNA wash buffer.

steps.title: Remove Residual Liquid
steps.instruction: Clear residual liquid from the beads using a retainer and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Move the beads to the bead retainer.
Pulse quickly in a bench-top centrifuge.

steps.title: Elute and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads and measure concentration.

substeps.instruction: Move the beads to a new clean tube.
Add 100 µL of Elution buffer.
Elute at 56 °C for 5 min.
Transfer the eluate to a fresh tube and measure with Nanodrop.

steps.title: Digest DNA to Nucleosides
steps.instruction: Perform enzymatic digestion of the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Perform reactions in 20 µL total volume.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 h.
Inactivate the enzyme at 80 °C for 15 min.
Store digested samples at 4 °C until analysis.
